==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. My goal was to send the Death Witch to a new world. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (The Death Witch resembles a woman with pale skin, straight black hair, red eyes, long tattered black robes, and a belt made of skulls. She is chained to a wall in a dungeon. She believes that humans should rule the world and that magical creatures should be subservient to mankind.)

I tried to explain to her how the waking world works, but I don't think she understood me.

Using my portal spell, I sent her to a world like ours where she can live among other humans. (Porta is the spell I use to summon portals.) (Without her magic, the Death Witch should be fairly harmless in a world like ours.)
